Past analyses of AAPL (most recent first):

[2026-08-18 | AAPL | Hold | -0.0% | +0.2% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Hold AAPL: maintain the core position at the standard 4–5% of portfolio NAV, initiate nothing at 310.03, and do nothing at all between 302.25 and 311.49 — that band is noise inside an unresolved range, not an entry. Treat 311.49/313.33 as an alert, not a trigger: the first tactical tranche (only 0.5–0.75% NAV, half the original plan) requires a daily close above 313.33 on >55M shares while holding the 310.69 gap floor, and the second tranche requires a MACD bullish crossover with price above 310.69–311.50, capping total AAPL exposure at 4–5%. Tactical adds carry the 298.50 hard stop; a close below 302.25 pauses adds and halves the tactical sleeve, below 300.00 trims the tactical sleeve and cuts core 20–25%, and below 280.87 questions the primary trend. Trim the tactical sleeve into 316.49, then 321.66–323.45, then 329.59, holding the core through the late-October FQ4 print and FY26 10-K.

**Investment Thesis**: The debate resolves to Hold, and unlike a lazy fence-sit this one is arithmetic: the bull case owns the business, the bear case owns the entry, and neither converts the other.

Why the bull does not get an add. AAPL closed at 310.03, below the unfilled 07-31 gap floor at 310.69 and below the bull's own 311.49 trigger. The "average-stack reclaim" of the 10-EMA (308.99), 50-SMA (309.13) and VWMA (309.70) is 0.04–0.14 ATR of clearance on each measure — statistically indistinguishable from touching the cluster. The 08-18 tape printed 53.4M shares, below the trader's own 55M volume condition and only ~40% of the 132.5M capitulation print of 07-31, and the VWMA has fallen twenty consecutive sessions from 329.58 to 309.70, i.e. real trapped supply sits just overhead. Momentum repair is real but incomplete: the MACD histogram contracted five sessions from −3.634 to −1.659 and the 10-EMA printed its first uptick since 07-30, yet MACD remains below zero at −2.459 against a still-falling signal at −0.800, and RSI at 47.86 offers no cushion. The aggressive analyst's central move — sizing off the 329.59 gap at ~1.39:1 — ignores that between 311.50 and the gap sit four shelves starting at 316.49, only ~5 points above entry against a 13-point stop, and the honest first-target ratio is ~0.38:1. He also waives the plan's own volume condition and leans on the Rothschild Redburn upgrade as institutional confirmation when the supplied news set is explicitly self-contradictory (a Buy and two cautious/bearish pieces inside the same 60-minute window on 08-17, with the target magnitude unverifiable). Sizing 1.0–1.5% NAV on that is paying up for a coin flip, and the stored lesson from 2026-08-05 — an AAPL Overweight that deployed a starter at ~311 ahead of its own 311.80/>65M gate and surrendered −3.1% of five-day alpha — is the direct precedent.

Why the bear does not get a trim. The same operating evidence that survives every seat: 9M FY26 revenue +16.2%, diluted EPS +22.4%, Q3 gross margin 50.06%, 33.6% operating margin, $62.2B net cash, debt down $14.4B, and a rising 200-SMA at 280.87 with price ~10.4% above it and the 50 over the 200. The bear's own material is framed as extrapolation risk, not deterioration — the $13.3B gross intangible against a $13.5B noncurrent-liability rise, cash taxes falling to 21.6% of pretax income and up to $10.8B of non-recurring CFO, inventory +94% with raw materials +260% against finished goods −4.1%, and a memory/China-sourcing overhang carried by the 08-14 WSJ report re-reported 08-17 plus a same-morning SeekingAlpha downgrade and a BofA/Micron note. Those are multi-quarter margin questions, not a broke franchise, and the technical picture is one of decelerating downside with a reclaimed cluster. My own record is unambiguous on this point: repeated AAPL Underweights on momentum decay inside a stacked uptrend (07-20 through 07-24, plus 07-31) each cost 2.1% to 13.6% of five-day alpha, and the most recent 08-11 Underweight was directionally wrong (+2.1% alpha) precisely because it acted on fading volume before a confirmed close below 300. So no Underweight, no pre-emptive short.

The only genuine disagreement left is execution, and the neutral analyst wins it with the conservative analyst's two corrections bolted on: raise the first add from 311.49 to 313.33 on >55M shares (costing <1.83 points of entry while materially cutting the failed-breakout-to-302 probability), cut the first tranche to 0.5–0.75% NAV so the MACD tranche still has ammunition, add an intermediate 302.25 alert ahead of 300.00, and trim the tactical sleeve more decisively at 316.49 as the most likely failure point. I explicitly reject the conservative's move to make 10-K clarity a months-long veto on any add — a small, hard-stopped tranche is not an abandonment of risk control — and I reject the aggressive's framing of absent sentiment data as "no froth": missing data reduces confidence, it never adds edge.

What would change the call. Upgrade to Overweight only on a daily close above 313.33 on >55M shares that holds the 310.69 gap floor, plus a MACD bullish crossover (or acceptance above 329.59 through the gap), corroborated by FQ4 gross margin ≥49.5% with inventory flat-to-down. Downgrade to Underweight on a daily close below 302.25 that fails to reclaim, or below 300.00 with the 50-SMA rolling above price; move toward Sell on a high-volume break of 298.50, FQ4 gross margin ≤47.5%, or inventory above ~$13–14B. Stated gaps, not papered over: no segment/product/geographic revenue split, so 50.06% gross-margin durability is unattributable; no independent valuation cross-check (the ~34x implied P/E is unverified against a consensus forward multiple); no options chain or implied-vol data, so any protective put or collar for the October window cannot be priced here; no insider/sentiment archive; the 08-11 to 08-15 news window is missing and the cause of the 07-31 gap is unresolved, so the $310.69–329.59 gap is carried as unquantified event risk rather than a target; and no portfolio context, so all sizing is expressed as a fraction of the caller's own standard AAPL weight, with the 316.49 level technical rather than valuation-derived.

**Price Target**: 316.49

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the late-October FQ4 FY26 print and FY26 10-K

REFLECTION:
The 5-day window returned -0.0% raw and +0.2% alpha versus SPY — a flat outcome that neither validates nor invalidates a 1–3 month Hold thesis, so treat it as no evidence rather than confirming evidence. What it does support is the execution logic: refusing to add at 310.03 with price below the 310.69 gap floor and the 311.49 trigger cost nothing, and the flat tape confirms the 302.25–311.49 band is noise rather than entry. Lesson for next time: when the add trigger sits only ~1% above spot, state explicitly that a flat 5-day print is the modal outcome and pre-commit to judging the call at the FQ4 print, not at day five.

[2026-08-17 | AAPL | Underweight | +1.6% | +2.7% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Underweight AAPL: hold no more than ~65-70% of the caller's standard AAPL weight at the 305.59 close, add nothing anywhere inside the 300.00-313.33 box, and trim toward ~55-60% only on failing strength into the 308.76/309.08/311.96 cluster (sub-50M volume, no positive MACD histogram turn). Cut to ~40-45% of standard on a daily close below 300.00, reassess rather than dump at 290.91 then the rising 200 SMA at 280.67, and move to Sell on a daily close below 280.67. Re-risk toward 90-100% of standard only on a daily close above 313.33 on >50M shares with the histogram turning positive or FQ4 gross-margin guidance at/above the ~49.1% nine-month run-rate framed as structural; abandon the Underweight above 333.43. Horizon 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the late-October FQ4 print.

**Investment Thesis**: All three risk seats converged on reducing exposure and none defended full size through the October gross-margin guide at 305.59; the neutral construction wins the expression question because it survives both other seats' best points.

The aggressive seat wins the DIRECTION on unrebutted evidence. AAPL is below the falling 10 EMA at 308.76, below a 50 SMA rolling over for six straight sessions (309.79 to 309.08), 2.04% below VWMA 311.96, and under a 314-333 supply shelf created by the -7.36% gap on 132.49M shares on 07-31. RSI 43.41 has ~13 points of room before oversold, the MACD line still makes lower lows at -2.676, five-session volume of 37.18M sits against that 132.49M distribution bar, and no >50M accumulation day exists. The valuation arithmetic nobody on the buy side put on the table is decisive: at $305.59 against ~$8.90 FY26 EPS (~$8.08 FQ3 run-rate) AAPL is a 34-38x stock on a 50.05% gross margin that ran 38-47% for a decade; 356 bps is too large for mix alone, and even 150 bps of reversion leaves forward EPS 4-6% too high. The cost headwinds are forward-looking (Jefferies at $263.66 on component costs, administration pressure on Chinese memory), and the inventory build (+94%, raw materials +260%, finished goods -4%, inventory days ~9.5 to ~18.5) defers rather than eliminates that step-up, into exactly the quarters being underwritten at 34x. Add a +219 bps tax drag, R&D +32.5% against revenue +16.2%, a 28.2% capex decline flattering FCF, and the unexplained $13.3bn intangible against a +$13.5bn other noncurrent liability, and the near-quarter skew is down. My own record corroborates: 08-06 Underweight (-3.4% alpha) and 08-10 Underweight (-0.8% alpha) both paid while the 08-07 Hold cost -2.7% alpha, and the decaying sequence 313.33 to 308.26 to 305.59 is distribution, not a coil.

The aggressive seat loses the EXPRESSION. Its 317.38 "stop loss" is the Bollinger middle band and the first bull target simultaneously, sits four points above the 313.33 rebuild trigger, and would fire the core out at the first leg of the breakout the plan itself says it wants to buy - a whipsaw generator. Its double-cut (trim at 305.59, cut again below 300.00, a 1.8% move apart) pays two transaction costs and possibly two tax events to express one view, with no visibility into cost basis, tax position or options mandate.

The conservative seat loses the CONCLUSION. Its hold-the-full-core-plus-290-puts plan is cleaner only if an options mandate exists, which nobody in the debate knows; strip the hedge and it is full-size passive exposure into a binary with VWMA above price and supply overhead - not conservative. It is also self-contradictory: a financing collar struck 313-320 caps precisely the move to 333.43 it uses as its central argument against trimming. Its "momentum bottoming" case (histogram -3.634 to -2.290 over four sessions, 28.23M lightest volume in forty sessions, a 0.12-point RSI divergence) is real but the source itself calls it marginal and unconfirmed; light volume on a fade is supply drying up or apathy before another leg lower.

What decided it is the asymmetry between a genuinely excellent franchise and an unattractive entry price. The business is not in doubt - FQ3 revenue +16.5%, gross margin 50.05%, diluted EPS +28.7%, $62.2bn net cash, ~$110bn nine-month FCF, buyback at ~$25bn or 67% of FCF, zero new long-term debt, price +8.88% above a rising 200 SMA with the golden cross live - which is why this is not a Sell, why the 300.00/302.56/300.57 triple-tested floor and 299.95 Fib are reasons to keep a core, and why the bear's implied "perfection is priced" is not grounds to exit. But at 34-38x on potentially peak margins, with forward numbers possibly 4-6% high and a hostile overhead structure, the next quarter's risk is skewed down. Prior lessons bind here: from the 08-06 decision, separate the tradeable tape signal from the fundamental de-rating case and size the trim to the former; from the 08-10 and 08-07 reflections, do not credit a sub-ATR window as evidence and do not let mid-box inertia pass for a decision - which is exactly why the trim level and the invalidation levels are pre-committed here rather than left to feel.

What would change it. Upgrade to Overweight: a daily close above 313.33 on >50M shares with the MACD histogram turning positive (not merely narrowing) - targets 317.38, then 321.66/327.74, then 333.43; or FQ4 gross-margin guidance at or above the ~49.1% nine-month run-rate explicitly framed as structural (Services mix) rather than one-off; or a >50M-share up-day inside the base. Abandon the Underweight above 333.43 where the shelf has failed. Downgrade to Sell: daily close below 280.67, or an FQ4 guide below 48% with revenue decelerating below 10% and inventory above ~$13-14bn. Data gaps stated, not papered over: no portfolio context (holdings, cash, cost basis, tax status, options mandate all unknown), so sizing is in fractions of the caller's own standard AAPL weight and the hedge leg is conditional; the $13.3bn intangible and +$13.5bn other noncurrent liability have no footnote; Alibaba China AI terms are undisclosed; KeyBanc/Gerber commentary is third-party and vague; the 28.2% capex decline flatters FCF; 145 of 165 news records are missing; and with no segment margin attribution or consensus series, the price target is technical, not valuation-derived.

**Price Target**: 294.0

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the late-October FQ4 FY2026 print

REFLECTION:
The 5-day alpha of +2.7% (raw +1.6% against a falling tape) went against the Underweight call, though five sessions is far too short to validate or refute a 1-3 month thesis built around the late-October FQ4 print. What this window undercuts is specifically the tape-derived trim rationale — the falling 10 EMA, rolling 50 SMA and distribution sequence did not produce the next leg lower, and price held the 300.00/302.56 floor that the thesis itself cited as the reason to keep a core. The fundamental de-rating case (34-38x on possibly peak margins, inventory build, tax drag) is untouched by five days of price action and remains the thing to re-underwrite at the print. Lesson for the next similar setup: when price is sitting on a triple-tested support with a live golden cross and price above a rising 200 SMA, do not trim at the level — require a confirmed daily close below the floor before expressing the tape view, so the trim is paid for by a break rather than by inertia at support.

[2026-08-14 | AAPL | Overweight | +1.1% | +2.5% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: Own more AAPL, but in gated tranches, not the trader's 30% at spot. Start 10% of the planned incremental add at ~305.93 and a second 10% only if the 300.00–304.30 rising-lows floor holds on the next session. Core add requires a daily close above 309.50 on more than 60M shares (50M is only ~1.07x the 46.6M ten-day average — no confirmation) closing above both the 10EMA 309.46 and 50SMA 309.19; if the 10/50 cross has already printed, require a close above VWMA 314.11 first. Cap at benchmark weight plus 1.5–2 points until the 333.43 gap fills or an official China Apple Intelligence launch confirms. Tactical stop 292.27 on a daily close, full invalidation a weekly close below 280.50; size so even an adverse gap through 292.27 costs no more than 40–50bp of total portfolio value. Horizon 1–3 months, re-underwritten at the late-October FQ4 print.

**Investment Thesis**: The direction is decided by the fundamentals; only the entry is contested, which is why this is Overweight and not Buy. The bull won the fundamentals decisively: 50.06% gross margin (+357bp), revenue +16.4% to $109.42B, operating income +26.6%, operating margin 32.62%, EPS $2.02 (+28.7%), incremental operating margin 44.6%. The decisive item is the one the bear never answered — operating margin expanded 152bp through a 32.5% R&D ramp, directly refuting his core claim that R&D erodes profitability; his retreat to "forward risk" is a hypothesis, not evidence. Net cash roughly doubling to $62.2B with debt down $14.4B and no new long-term issuance, plus buybacks re-accelerating to $25.1B (+19% y/y) in the exact quarter the stock was weak, is the only management-conviction signal in the dataset. The primary trend is intact: price 9.07% above a rising 200SMA at 280.48, 50/200 spread +10.2%, no death cross in play.

The bear's tape work wins the entry, not the direction. Eleven straight closes below the 50SMA at 309.19 with failed reclaims, VWMA at 314.11 above spot so the volume-weighted buyer is underwater, an entirely unfilled 304.81–333.43 gap as overhead supply, and a decaying bounce of 75M → 68M → 49M → 46M → 34M → 28.23M (lightest since late March, ~39% below the 46.6M ten-day average). That damages the bull's "unpriced catalyst" claim: you do not get accumulation on the lightest volume in four months, and the China LLM story is a single Reuters relay with unnamed sources and a "coming months" timeline. The neutral analyst is also right that upside to 333.43 must clear 309.50, 314.11, 316.29 and 318.43 — four resistance layers, not one magnet — and that a daily-close stop does not cap a gap, as 2026-07-31 proved (333.43 to a 304.81 open on 132.5M shares).

What caps the bear's win is his own concession: he stands down on a close above 309.50 on volume, so his entire thesis lives inside a ~1.2% band, and he offers no lower terminal value — inventory math of $0.06–0.09 EPS against $54.77B of quarterly gross profit, an unquantified intangible complaint, and a real 219bp tax drag that still coexisted with 28.7% EPS growth. He states the business isn't broken. That is a timing argument, not a valuation argument, so the evidence is not balanced and Hold is wrong.

Where I overrule the trader: a 30% starter at spot is too much against MACD below zero, decaying volume, and an imminent 10/50 cross (10EMA 309.46 vs 50SMA 309.19).
